cases.input: Render all slides and a PDF, inspect slide-level and deck-level quality, correct findings, rerender and only then issue the final status.
requiredBehaviors: perform actual slide and PDF rendering
inspect both individual slides and deck-level consistency
rerender after corrections before final PASS
forbiddenBehaviors: claim visually verified without a render
treat PDF export alone as proof of editable PPTX quality

cases.input: The PPTX render is clean but the PDF substitutes a font and changes line breaks on two slides.
requiredBehaviors: treat PDF as a second renderer with independent findings
report parity issues instead of accepting the clean PPTX render
rerender after the font issue is corrected
forbiddenBehaviors: declare final PASS from PPTX render only

cases.input: No rendering tool is available, so the reviewer inspects slide XML, assumes the deck looks fine and reports pass.
requiredBehaviors: return fail or unverified when no real render is available
avoid converting structural inspection into visual evidence
preserve the requirement for a later real render
skillAnchors: prüft, was der Betrachter tatsächlich sieht
